notes: Gate 1 (YAML twin, ADR-0059): fixtures whose input is deliberately format-native, so reading the same text as YAML is expected to report a different error. Each entry names why. Every port also skips the provider-extension-* fixtures whose test-only providers it cannot compose.

exclusions.error-attr-child-not-object: Asserts a JSON-shaped body error; the YAML desugar reads a scalar body as { name: <scalar> } (ADR-0006 rule 2).
exclusions.error-measure-default-on-count-non-numer: Asserts a JSON value-type error on the quoted "zero"; the YAML coercion guard (ADR-0006 D2) reports ERR_YAML_COERCION under its own code.
exclusions.error-attr-wrong-type: Asserts a JSON value-type error that the YAML coercion guard (ADR-0006 D2) reports under its own code.
exclusions.error-bare-key-no-concrete-default: A bare type key is YAML sugar for the default subtype (ADR-0006 rule 1); in canonical JSON it is an error.
exclusions.error-bare-key-type-without-base: A bare type key is YAML sugar for the default subtype (ADR-0006 rule 1); in canonical JSON it is an error.
exclusions.error-child-not-object: Asserts a JSON-shaped child error; the YAML desugar reads a scalar body as { name: <scalar> } (ADR-0006 rule 2).
exclusions.error-parse-malformed-json: Malformed JSON is a JSON parse error; the YAML parser reports its own.
exclusions.error-provided-not-boolean: Asserts a JSON value-type error that the YAML coercion guard (ADR-0006 D2) reports under its own code.
exclusions.error-root-not-object: Asserts a JSON document-shape error; YAML reads the same document differently.
exclusions.error-unknown-bare-child-type: A bare type key is YAML sugar for the default subtype (ADR-0006 rule 1); in canonical JSON it is an error.
